text:
anya: Uploaded the updated Figma for Rollouts -> Canary view: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see Compact Timeline + Traffic slider). Looking for quick UX + copy + a11y notes.
kevin: nice! i like the compact timeline. one quick thing — the slider feels too jumpy when dragging. can we add snap points at 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100?
rachel: agreed on snap points. also suggest copy tweak: instead of 'Rollout %' use 'Traffic to new version' — clearer for non-dev users.
sam: from infra side, defaulting to 5% makes sense. we also need an explicit 'save as step' button so we don't create half-finished rollouts accidentally.
lina: a11y nit — the contrast on the green progress bar is borderline. please check AA contrast ratio. Also keyboard interaction: slider must support arrow keys and PageUp/PageDown for bigger steps.
kevin: for keyboard we'll implement step sizes: arrows = 1, shift+arrows = 5, PageUp/PageDown = 10. aria label should read something like 'Traffic to new version, currently 5 percent'.
anya: thanks — can someone propose exact copy for the tooltip and the confirmation modal? I want one-liners i can paste into figma.
julie: tooltip idea: 'Route X% of traffic to version v3. Supports canary and A/B experiments.' Confirmation modal headline: 'Start rollout to version v3' body: 'This will route X% of live traffic to v3. You can pause or rollback at any time.' Primary CTA: 'Start rollout' Secondary: 'Cancel'.
kevin: small micro-interaction: when you increase slider, show a transient badge on the timeline node that says '+X%' and a link to 'view recent rollouts'. helps trace churn.
anya: timeline question — should repeated small rollouts by the same user collapse into one line item (group by actor/time window) or show every event? i worry about visual noise.
sam: collapse by default, expandable on click. backend already groups events within 10 minutes by the same actor, so UI can mirror that.
lina: make sure the expand/collapse state is keyboard focusable and announces state for screen readers: 'Show more rollouts (collapsed) -> expanded'.
kevin: copy nit for the version badge: change from 'v3 • active' to 'v3 — live (50%)' so it's scannable.
anya: good call. also, for A/B tests: do we surface cohort assignment in the rollout modal or keep it in a separate 'Experiment' flow?
julie: keep basic cohort selector inline (small link: 'Assign cohorts'), but full experiment config in a separate modal so we don't overwhelm first-time users.
kevin: UI note: add a tiny '?' help icon next to 'Assign cohorts' that opens a quick tooltip with 'cohorts are groups of users defined by rules'.
lina: also ensure the tooltip content is accessible (focusable, escape to close, not just hover-only).
deploy-bot: Canary started: version v3 -> 5% traffic (initiated by anya) — job id: r-2026-03-22-009
rachel: thanks deploy-bot :thumbsup: one last ask — add a small 'estimated cost impact' line in the modal (very approximate) so PMs can see cost implications.
sam: we can surface a ballpark number based on tokens/sec and current traffic. will add as 'Est. monthly delta: ~$X'.
anya: perfect. i'll update figma with these copy changes and a11y notes then post a new link. can folks react with :eyes: when they review the next iteration? thanks everyone!
